text: Send messages programmatically through the API to recipients in the To, Cc, and Bcc headers
quote: Sends the specified message to the recipients in the `To`, `Cc`, and `Bcc` headers.

text: REST API to view and manage mailbox data such as threads, messages, and labels
quote: The Gmail API lets you view and manage Gmail mailbox data like threads, messages, and labels.

text: API can create drafts, which get the DRAFT label
quote: Creates a draft with the `DRAFT` label.

text: API can send an existing draft using the drafts.send method
quote: You can send it from a draft, using the drafts.send method.

text: API can immediately and permanently delete a specified draft
quote: Immediately and permanently deletes the specified draft.

text: API takes RFC 2822-compliant MIME messages encoded as base64URL strings
quote: The Gmail API requires MIME email messages compliant with RFC 2822 and encoded as base64URL strings.

text: Server push notifications let you watch Gmail mailboxes for changes
quote: The Gmail API provides server push notifications that let you watch for changes to Gmail mailboxes.

text: Apps can request narrow, non-sensitive OAuth scopes so they only get access to the features they need
quote: Whenever possible, use non-sensitive scopes to narrow access to only the specific features needed by an app.

text: API supports read-only mail extraction, indexing, and backup
quote: Read-only mail extraction, indexing, and backup

text: API supports migrating email accounts
quote: Migração de conta de e-mail

text: API can standardize email signatures across an organization
quote: Padronização de assinaturas de e-mail em uma organização

text: Workspace add-ons show an interactive custom UI when a user reads or composes a message
quote: When a user reads or composes a message in Gmail, a Google Workspace add-on can present an interactive, customized UI that lets the user act on the message

text: Add-ons can automatically create new message drafts in response to user interactions
quote: Automatically create new message drafts in response to user interactions.

text: Gmail add-ons work on both desktop and mobile clients
quote: Additionally, add-ons that extend Gmail do so on both desktop and mobile clients.

text: Gmail supports standard IMAP, POP, and SMTP protocols for non-Gmail clients
quote: En el caso de los clientes que no son de Gmail, Gmail admite los protocolos estándar IMAP, POP y SMTP.

text: Gmail can be added to Outlook, Apple Mail, or Thunderbird, with messages and labels synced
quote: You can add Gmail to other email clients, like Microsoft Outlook, Apple Mail, or Mozilla Thunderbird. When you add Gmail, your messages and labels are synced

text: IMAP, POP, and SMTP servers support OAuth 2.0 authorization
quote: The Gmail IMAP, POP, and SMTP servers support authorization with the industry-standard OAuth 2.0 protocol.

text: Snooze an email so it leaves the inbox and returns at a chosen time
quote: Your email comes back to the top of your inbox when you want it to, whether that's tomorrow, next week, or in the evening.

text: Find snoozed emails by searching in:snoozed
quote: To search for snoozed emails, at the top, in the search bar, enter `in:snoozed`.

text: Read, search, and reply to messages offline without an internet connection
quote: You can use Gmail offline to read, search, and reply to messages without an internet connection.

text: Messages sent offline wait in an Outbox and send automatically when you reconnect
quote: If you send a message offline, it's saved in a new "Outbox" folder. If you connect to the internet, the message is sent automatically.

text: Undo Send lets you retract a sent message within a cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds
quote: Next to "Undo Send," select a Send cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds.

text: Grant delegates access to read, send, and delete mail and to view and add contacts on your behalf
quote: Delegates can read, send, and delete messages, as well as view and add contacts on behalf of the delegator's account.

text: Search operators, which can be combined, filter search results
quote: You can use words or symbols called search operators to filter your Gmail search results. You can also combine operators to filter your results even more.

text: Create a filter directly from search results
quote: After you search, you can use the results to set up a filter for these messages.

text: Filters match incoming mail on criteria like sender, subject, or size
quote: Advanced rules configured for an account that evaluate incoming messages against specific matching criteria (like sender, subject, or size).

text: Matching filters automatically add or remove labels or forward the email to a specified address
quote: When a message matches, filters automatically trigger actions such as adding or removing labels, or forwarding the email to a specified address.

text: Gemini summarizes long email threads into concise bullet points
quote: Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points.

text: Ask Gemini to organize mail, such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels
quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.

text: Gemini creates new emails or refines existing drafts for tone and clarity
quote: Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.

text: Suggested replies let you reply in one click, in your own voice
quote: suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.

text: Gemini proposes meeting times based on your Google Calendar availability
quote: Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.

text: Hide a recipient's address by adding them in the Bcc field
quote: If you're sending a message and want to hide a recipient's email address, you can add them in the "Bcc" field.

text: Secure custom business email on your own domain
quote: Secure custom business email you@your-company.com
